shortDescription: Manage a BGP Policy Import/Export Rule

options.name: address_prefix
options.description: List of dicts with "name"/"exact" keys. Using the dict form for address prefixes should only be used with I(policy_type=aggregate).

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: commit
options.description: B(Deprecated) Please use M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_firewall), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_panorama), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_push) instead. HORIZONTALLINE Commit changes after creating object.  If I(ip_address) is a Panorama device, and I(device_group) or I(template) are also set, perform a commit to Panorama and a commit-all to the device group/template.

options.name: enable
options.description: Enable filter.

options.name: filter_type
options.description: The type of filter.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: match_afi
options.description: Address Family Identifier.

options.name: match_as_path_regex
options.description: AS-path regular expression.

options.name: match_community_regex
options.description: Community AS-path regular expression.

options.name: match_extended_community_regex
options.description: Extended Community AS-path regular expression.

options.name: match_from_peer
options.description: Filter by peer that sent this route.

options.name: match_med
options.description: Multi-Exit Discriminator.

options.name: match_nexthop
options.description: Next-hop attributes.

options.name: match_route_table
options.description: Route table to match rule.

options.name: match_safi
options.description: Subsequent Address Family Identifier.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of filter.

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: policy_name
options.description: The name of the policy object.

options.name: policy_type
options.description: The type of policy object.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: Add or remove BGP Policy Filter. I(state=return-object) is deprecated and will be removed in 2.12.

options.name: template
options.description: (Panorama only) The template this operation should target. Mutually exclusive with I(template_stack).

options.name: template_stack
options.description: (Panorama only) The template stack this operation should target. Mutually exclusive with I(template).

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: vr_name
options.description: Name of the virtual router; it must already exist and have BGP configured. See M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_virtual_router).
